behavior: Tab in a submenu of a context menu closes each menu of the context menu with the reason `focus-out`. The focus then goes where Tab in the root sends it: to the element that had it before the menu opened. The WAI-ARIA menu pattern asks for this, and Tab in a submenu of a menu with a trigger does it in both libraries. In Base UI, a submenu of a context menu does not handle Tab, so the key moves the focus out of the submenu. A focus guard of the modal popup of the root then focuses the first tabbable element of that popup: the submenu trigger. Each submenu thus closes, but the root stays open. Shift+Tab in a submenu still closes only that submenu, as in Base UI.
